lead: A commit message carries no attribution trailer, and two gates enforce it.
body: `bun nv session` strips `Co-Authored-By`, `Signed-off-by`, `Generated-with` and the prose `🤖 Generated with …` line out of any message it commits (`tools/nv/cmd/session.ts`); `tools/git-hooks/commit-msg` rejects one arriving by `-m`, `-F`, an editor or a merge. The hook is off until `git config core.hooksPath tools/git-hooks` has been run once per clone — `nv verify` says so when it is not set — and conventions.md § *A commit message* is the rule's home.
